title: Any-true Boolean computation
statement: The designated finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet computes the function sending each Boolean word $x$ to the one-symbol word whose bit is true exactly when at least one bit of $x$ is true, in time $|x|+1$.
caveat: The statement names f2_anyTrueTM, but its definition is not included among the supplied definitions, so the machine's identity cannot be described more specifically.
